regions.merged_text: Mrs. Marguerite Mc Conkey - 34 - convert from unitarinism & Baptism - has been deserted by husband, simply because she gently insisted on going to Holy Communion. Her first fearful cross was the sight of her dear parents becoming divorced. This also was first incen- tive to examine into the one Church so absolutely against such a moral & social pest. Apr. 14 Reported "Back home & more reasonable."

Amputation, they said, should be at once - last Monday, but at latest following Thursday (To-day) - is feeling better now, was enrolled - Father promises perpetual ... if ...
